Ecology PhD student with extensive experience in open science, quantitative workflow and project management, and code reproducibility. Proven track record of establishing ***version-controlled analytical frameworks*** for ***large-scale collaborative programmes*** ([Bird Count India](https://birdcount.in/), [State of India's Birds](https://stateofindiasbirds.in/)), developing R packages, and contributing directly to open science advancement. Strong ***attention to detail across mediums***, and passionate about written communication, code clarity, and ***transparency and accessibility*** in research.

# Core Skills

## Programming

- Fluent in R (advanced data wrangling, statistical ecology, package development), RMarkdown & Quarto (manuscripts, `xaringan`/`Reveal.js` slide decks, websites), Git & GitHub
- Basic experience with Shell scripting for automation, and with CSS and HTML in conjunction with RMarkdown/Quarto
- Cursory experience with Python and Julia syntax

## Open-source & code standards

- Project-based workflows, script parameterisation & functionisation, version control, code annotation & documentation
- Code review in ecology research, testing and validation of package code

## Editorial & communication

- Academic peer-review, citizen science data quality review
- Technical copy editing & proofreading
- Workshop instruction, coding mentoring 

# Relevant Experience

## Coding in research

<br> 

### Package development

- **`skimmr` package:** Developed and maintained an [open-source R package](https://github.com/rikudoukarthik/skimmr), with code testing and validation, to streamline eBird data workflows and make data manipulation accessible for researchers in the Indian context

### State of India’s Birds 2023

<!-- make this SoIB heading, and below BCI  -->

- Served as Senior Research Assistant at Nature Conservation Foundation, India (2023--24)
- Developed modular pipeline framework---unifying complex data wrangling, statistical, and visualisation scripts---for the multi-institutional collaborative project, [SoIB 2023](https://doi.org/10.1002/ecs2.70290)
- Parameterised and functionalised legacy scripts, adding detailed documentation and annotations to improve long-term usability and accessibility for internal teams and external collaborators
- Structured, cleaned, and organised GitHub repositories for public archiving to meet rigorous open-science standards

### Bird Count India

- Served as Research Assistant at Nature Conservation Foundation, India (2021--23)
- Established comprehensive version-controlled workflows across several [Bird Count India](https://birdcount.in/) analyses, to enforce reproducibility and transparency across multi-researcher and multi-timeline projects
- Automated periodic data processing pipelines and internal metric tracking
- Created public-facing Shiny app to generate live summaries via the eBird API

## Editorial & review

- **State of India’s Birds 2023:** Led copy editing, proofreading and bibliography management for the [public-facing technical report](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11124589)
- **Conference proceedings:** Managed editorial workflows, proofreading, typesetting, and publishing for academic conference proceedings at Christ University, Bengaluru, India
- **Academic peer-review:** Provided constructive peer-review evaluations for academic journals (e.g., *Journal of Threatened Taxa*, *Indian BIRDS*), with special focus on methodology, data integrity, analytical robustness, and reproducibility (2025--present)
- **Citizen science:** Contributed to improving eBird India data quality by serving as Regional Reviewer and Hotspot Editor for India (2022--present)

## Advancing open science

- **BES Data and Code Hackathon Group:** Co-authored and contributed to recent *Methods in Ecology and Evolution* publication evaluating data- and code-archiving practices across BES journals, establishing recommendations for future methodological improvements
- **Instructor, GitHub workshop:** Led practical workshop introducing members of Montaño Lab at LSU to project-based workflows, repository structures, Git basics, and version control integration in everyday research pipelines
- **Instructor, R & eBird data analysis workshops:** Designed and led hands-on training sessions at Kerala Bird Monitoring Meets (2023, 2024), guiding researchers and citizen scientists through clean coding practices, eBird (big) data wrangling, and reproducible analysis in R
- **Coding mentor, LSU LAGNIAppE Programme:** Mentored post-baccalaureate scholar in R programming, script optimisation, and version control (2025--26)
